answer: The horizon index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the quill queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 966 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the meadow. Honest users pay that once, farms 23 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
